notes: Evidence is only a page title; facets rely on prior knowledge of the company.

food_beverage_category.value: Hot dogs and other beef frankfurters and processed meats, plus Nathan's branded restaurants and licensed foodservice

brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned Nathan's Famous brand, licensed to retailers and foodservice; products made by third-party co-packers, notably Smithfield

processing_technology.value: Products made by third-party co-packers; company does not run its own processing

temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Refrigerated and frozen meat distribution through third-party distributors and co-packers

customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Mix of branded product sales to foodservice and grocery retail (supermarket) channels, with licensing and royalties and a few company-owned restaurants

input_food_safety_exposure.value: Exposure to beef price swings and meat food-safety and recall risk, handled through supply agreements with the co-packer
